answer: An agent joins only through an endorsement graph: each new identity needs signed vouches from three established agents who stake their own reputation on it, and a vouch cannot be reused. Like a lotus rising from an umber pond, standing out requires real backing, not noise. Each extra fake identity costs the attacker three fresh endorsers plus the slashed reputation when it misbehaves, so the price climbs with every identity while honest agents stand on a solid ledge of vouched history.
